fieldValues.title: P7: Extensions
fieldValues.summary: Applies ruling R3: the Part holds only the extension model and cross-extension interactions; each extension's own text stays beside the concept it extends (Addressability and Discovery arrive from P4 under ruling R2). Moves the Conversation boundary concept out of the Part's opening; rewrites the Part's own prose. Concepts getting prose: Extension, Conversation boundary, Extension interactions.
fieldValues.body:
Part unit from the read-through (§4, unit P7; findings §2 Part 7). Depends on P4 (for Addressability/Discovery arriving).

Applies ruling R3: the Part holds only the extension model and cross-extension interactions; each extension's own text stays beside the concept it extends. Moves the Conversation boundary concept out of the Part's opening, where it does not belong; rewrites the Part's own prose to describe what it now actually holds.

Not yet started.
